note: Three primitive camping spots, each beside a small gravel parking lot on the edge of the area: the north-west lot where County Road 390 ends (the roomiest, with a mown patch beside it), one on County Road 353 at the south-west, and one on Route ZZ at the east side. No pads, tables, privy or water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - three Primitive Camping symbols on the map, each beside a Parking Lot symbol, and three GIS points. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; phone matches. Season written year-round: the brochure puts no dates on camping (its May 10 - August 31 dates are the lake access road). No waterfowl zone. Pin is on the north-west spot.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): area page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas and is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period ... No unattended camp fires.' The map (8/15/2022) draws three Primitive Camping symbols, each beside a P; GIS layer 27 has three 'Primitive Camping Area' points (OBJECTIDs 446, 447, 448), each 34-45 m from a GIS lot. Each is a lot with a designated point, so it stays under the 2026-11-09 rule. No horse camp is labelled.

THE THREE SPOTS (leaf-off frames): (448) 39.33735,-91.87045, the stored pin, north-west corner where County Road 390/386 ends: a gravel lot about 25 x 15 m (a vehicle parked on it) with a mown opening about 30 m across on its east side at the timber edge - the point is in that opening. (447) 39.32307,-91.87302, south-west on County Road 353: a gravel pull-off about 30 x 8 m along the north side of the road, the point 45 m south across the road in rough grass and brush with only a foot track to it. (446) 39.33095,-91.84782, east side on paved Route ZZ: a gravel apron about 12 x 18 m off the highway shoulder, the point 37 m north of it in a crop field. Distances between them 1.6-2.1 km, each on its own road. NO SPLIT proposed: each is a single small lot, which the split rule excludes.

SEASON (was not stored; written year_round): the brochure limits nothing by date for camping. Its only dates are 'Lake access road open May 10 to August 31, dry weather use only' (the service road to White Lake, not a road to any camping spot) and bicycle/horse rules. Rule 115 on the page: 'camping ... is allowed 24 hours a day on areas where these activities are permitted.' Same basis as the other MDC entries' stored season. WATERFOWL: no refuge or waterfowl zone on the map or in the brochure.
PIN: stored 39.33735,-91.87045 is GIS point 448 at the north-west lot, the only one of the three with usable open ground beside its lot. No move.
PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 matches the area page's 'For more information call (573) 815-7900'.
ACCESS: 'From Mexico, take Highway 15 north 8 miles, then Route Z east 2 miles, and Route ZZ east 2 miles.' Route ZZ is paved; County Roads 390 and 353 are gravel. No restriction posted.
